name: xer_list_files
title: List XER files
description: Find .xer files in a folder (default: the working folder), newest first.

args.name: folder
args.description: Folder to search; defaults to the working folder

name: xer_open
title: Open XER file
description: Load an XER file and list the projects and tables in it. Call this first to see what an XER contains; the other xer_* tools load the file on demand too.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

name: xer_project_summary
title: Project summary
description: Key facts about a project in an XER: data date, start and finish, must-finish-by, activity counts by status and type, percent complete, critical and negative-float counts, cost totals.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

args.name: criticalFloat
args.description: Total float (days) at or below which an activity counts as critical

name: xer_list_activities
title: List activities
description: Activities in the project, ordered by start, with optional filters. Durations and floats are working days; dates are P6 dates (actual where they exist, otherwise forecast).

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

args.name: types
args.description: Activity types, e.g. 'Task Dependent', 'Milestone', 'Level of Effort' (substring match)

args.name: wbs
args.description: WBS code prefix (e.g. '1.2') or part of a WBS name

args.name: search
args.description: Substring of activity ID or name

args.name: maxFloat
args.description: Only activities with total float <= this many days

args.name: minFloat
args.description: Only activities with total float >= this many days

args.name: longestPathOnly
args.description: Only activities P6 flagged as on the longest path

args.name: startsAfter
args.description: YYYY-MM-DD

args.name: finishesBefore
args.description: YYYY-MM-DD

args.name: resource
args.description: Resource ID or name assigned to the activity

name: xer_get_activity
title: Get activity
description: Everything about one activity: dates, durations, floats, constraint, calendar, WBS path, predecessors, successors and resource assignments.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

args.name: activityId
args.description: Activity ID as shown in P6, e.g. A1010

name: xer_wbs
title: WBS tree
description: The project's WBS as a tree, with activity count, start, finish and lowest total float under each element.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

name: xer_critical_path
title: Critical path
description: Incomplete activities with total float at or below a threshold (default 0) or on P6's longest path, in start order.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

args.name: floatThreshold
args.description: Days of total float that still count as critical

name: xer_driving_path
title: Driving path to an activity
description: Trace the chain of driving predecessors back from an activity (default: the one that finishes last) to the data date. Use it to explain why a milestone finishes when it does.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

args.name: activityId
args.description: Target activity ID; defaults to the latest-finishing incomplete activity

name: xer_schedule_health
title: Schedule health check (DCMA 14-point)
description: Run the DCMA 14-point assessment: logic, leads, lags, relationship types, hard constraints, high float, negative float, high duration, invalid dates, resources, missed tasks, critical path test, CPLI and BEI. Each check lists offending activities. Pass a baseline XER for checks 11 and 14; otherwise planned dates are used.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

args.name: baselineFile
args.description: XER of the baseline schedule, matched by activity ID

name: xer_compare
title: Compare two schedules
description: Compare two XERs of the same project (e.g. last month's update and this month's): finish slip, data date move, activities added and removed, changed durations, dates, float, status and constraints, and logic added, removed or with changed lag. Matching is by activity ID.

args.name: previousFile
args.description: Earlier XER (baseline or previous update)

args.name: currentFile
args.description: Later XER

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

args.name: previousProject
args.description: Project ID in the earlier file if it differs

args.name: limit
args.description: Maximum items per list

name: xer_lookahead
title: Look-ahead
description: Incomplete activities that are in progress, start or finish within the next N days from the data date (or a given date). Good for 2-, 3- or 6-week look-aheads.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

args.name: from
args.description: YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the data date

name: xer_resources
title: Resource loading
description: Resources assigned in the project with planned, actual and remaining units and costs.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: project
args.description: Project ID (short name) when the XER holds more than one project

name: xer_query_table
title: Query raw XER table
description: Read rows from any table in the XER (e.g. TASK, TASKPRED, PROJWBS, CALENDAR, RSRC, TASKRSRC, ACTVCODE, TASKACTV, UDFVALUE) with field names as P6 exports them. Use it for data the other tools don't cover.

args.name: file
args.description: Path to the .xer file (absolute, or relative to the working folder)

args.name: table
args.description: Table name, e.g. TASK

args.name: where
args.description: Exact-match filters, e.g. { "proj_id": "4512" }

args.name: contains
args.description: Keep rows where any field contains this text (case-insensitive)

args.name: fields
args.description: Fields to return; default all
